description: Call any GitHub REST endpoint via gh api: { path: "repos/OWNER/REPO/issues", method?, fields?, body?, jq?, paginate?, timeout_ms? } -> { value: <parsed JSON> }. fields become -f key=value form fields (default method flips to POST); body is sent verbatim as the JSON request body. Non-2xx responses are errors carrying gh's stderr.

body.description: Raw JSON request body, piped to gh via `--input -`. Mutually exclusive with fields (gh rejects the combination).

fields.description: Form fields, each passed as `-f key=value` (string-typed on the wire).

jq.description: jq expression gh applies to the response (`--jq`); keeps large responses small.

method.description: HTTP method. gh defaults to GET, or POST when fields/body are present.

paginate.description: Follow pagination to the end (`--paginate`); combine with jq.

path.description: Endpoint path, with concrete owner/repo values (e.g. "rate_limit" or "repos/cli/cli/issues") — placeholder expansion needs a checkout the worker does not have.

timeout_ms.description: Per-call timeout in ms, clamped to the configured max_timeout_ms.

response_schema.description: Parsed `--json` output of a gh command.

value.description: The JSON gh printed for the requested `--json` fields.

response_schema.title: ValueResponse
